static_files.Import-ADUsers.ps1:
<#
  Import-ADUsers.ps1 - creates or updates Active Directory accounts from the SAM Ad Hoc Query Builder files.
  Run on a domain controller or a PC with RSAT (ActiveDirectory module) as a domain admin:
      .\Import-ADUsers.ps1 -CsvPath .\ad_students.csv            # preview only (no changes)
      .\Import-ADUsers.ps1 -CsvPath .\ad_students.csv -Apply     # make the changes
  New accounts get the Password column and must change it at first sign-in. Existing accounts (matched on
  SamAccountName) get names, email, school, title and employee ID updated - passwords are NOT changed.
  Accounts are never deleted or disabled by this script.
#>
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$CsvPath, [switch]$Apply)
Import-Module ActiveDirectory
$log = Join-Path (Split-Path $CsvPath) ("ad_import_{0:yyyy-MM-dd_HHmm}.log" -f (Get-Date))
foreach ($u in Import-Csv $CsvPath) {
    if (-not $u.SamAccountName) { continue }
    $props = @{ GivenName = $u.GivenName; Surname = $u.Surname; DisplayName = $u.DisplayName;
                EmailAddress = $u.EmailAddress; UserPrincipalName = $u.UserPrincipalName;
                Department = $u.Department; Title = $u.Title; EmployeeID = $u.EmployeeID; Company = $u.Company }
    $existing = Get-ADUser -Filter "SamAccountName -eq '$($u.SamAccountName)'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($existing) {
        "UPDATE $($u.SamAccountName)" | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append
        if ($Apply) { Set-ADUser $existing @props }
    } else {
        "CREATE $($u.SamAccountName) in $($u.Path)" | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append
        if ($Apply) {
            New-ADUser -Name $u.DisplayName -SamAccountName $u.SamAccountName -Path $u.Path @props `
                -AccountPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString $u.Password -AsPlainText -Force) `
                -ChangePasswordAtLogon $true -Enabled $true
        }
    }
}
if (-not $Apply) { "Preview only - run again with -Apply to make these changes." }

static_files.Disable-ADUsers.ps1:
<#
  Disable-ADUsers.ps1 - disables Active Directory accounts listed in shutoff_students.csv / shutoff_staff.csv.
      .\Disable-ADUsers.ps1 -CsvPath .\shutoff_students.csv                 # preview only
      .\Disable-ADUsers.ps1 -CsvPath .\shutoff_students.csv -Apply          # disable
      .\Disable-ADUsers.ps1 -CsvPath .\shutoff_staff.csv -Apply -MoveToOU "OU=Disabled,DC=district,DC=local"
  Accounts are matched on the Username column (SamAccountName) and are DISABLED, never deleted.
#>
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$CsvPath, [switch]$Apply, [string]$MoveToOU)
Import-Module ActiveDirectory
$log = Join-Path (Split-Path $CsvPath) ("ad_disable_{0:yyyy-MM-dd_HHmm}.log" -f (Get-Date))
foreach ($u in Import-Csv $CsvPath) {
    if (-not $u.Username) { continue }
    $acct = Get-ADUser -Filter "SamAccountName -eq '$($u.Username)'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $acct) { "NOT FOUND $($u.Username)" | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append; continue }
    "DISABLE $($u.Username) ($($u.'Last Name'), $($u.'First Name'))" | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append
    if ($Apply) {
        Disable-ADAccount $acct
        Set-ADUser $acct -Description ("Disabled {0:yyyy-MM-dd} by SAM Ad Hoc Query Builder shutoff list" -f (Get-Date))
        if ($MoveToOU) { Move-ADObject $acct -TargetPath $MoveToOU }
    }
}
if (-not $Apply) { "Preview only - run again with -Apply to disable these accounts." }

platforms.confirm_with_vendor: Check the Google file against Admin console > Users > Bulk update > Download blank CSV template; the status column name has changed before.

platforms.works_with: MyNAEP > Submit Student List (sampled schools only, fall) and the January list update
platforms.description: Every enrolled student in the NAEP grade(s) (4, 8 and 12 - remove the grades your school wasn't sampled for in Step 4) in the NAEP E-File one-column race/ethnicity layout: State unique Student ID (MSIS), first / middle / last name, Grade in School, homeroom as the locator, Month and Year of Birth, Sex, Race/Ethnicity, NSLP, SD (Yes, IEP / No, not SD), EL, On-Break Indicator and ZIP. NAEP accepts your school's own codes for Sex, Race/Ethnicity and NSLP - you match each SAM code to NAEP's categories when you upload. SAM has no general EL flag, so the EL column is blank: fill it from your EL records (Yes, EL / No, not EL / No, formerly EL). Save the CSV as Excel (.xlsx) for MyNAEP.
platforms.delivery: MyNAEP (mynaep.com) > Submit Student List - upload as Excel
platforms.confirm_with_vendor: Use this year's E-File template from MyNAEP and check the column order and the race/ethnicity version (one, two or six columns) your school was given.

platforms.name: YellowFolder (digital student & staff records)
platforms.works_with: YellowFolder by Intellinetics - cumulative folders, scanning and records retention
platforms.description: Index files so scanned documents land in the right folder: EVERY student with a primary school - current, withdrawn and graduated (records outlive enrollment) - with IDs, MSIS, birth date, grade, graduation year, school, enrollment status and graduation date, and every employee with hire and termination dates for HR folders. Use the Schools: button or a filter in Step 4 if YellowFolder only wants recent years.
platforms.delivery: SFTP or upload agreed with YellowFolder support (often nightly)
platforms.confirm_with_vendor: This vendor does not publish a fixed file layout - columns are mapped when the file is uploaded. Send the vendor a sample before going live and rename headings in Step 3 if they ask. Ask whether they want withdrawn and graduated students and how far back.

platforms.name: Parchment (transcripts, diplomas & records requests)
platforms.works_with: Parchment Send K-12 > Students > Roster upload (registration codes)
platforms.description: Parchment's student roster: the five required fields (First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Student ID, Graduation Year) plus middle name, email (needed to email registration codes) and mailing address. One file for students in grades 9-12, one for graduates of the last ~13 months (they still order transcripts). Parchment lets you match columns when you upload, so the order isn't fixed - tick 'file has a header row' and choose Comma Delimited.
platforms.delivery: Parchment Send K-12 (exchange.parchment.com) > Students > Upload roster

platforms.name: Glimpse K12 (ed-tech usage & ROI analytics)
platforms.works_with: Glimpse K12 by Level Data - links app usage to students, teachers, classes and outcomes
platforms.description: Who uses each program: enrolled students with school email (matched to app logins), grade, school and demographics for equity reports (gender, race, home language, SPED / 504 / gifted Y/N, meal status), active staff with emails, and live class enrollments with the teacher. If Glimpse can take OneRoster instead, the OneRoster 1.1 package has the same data. Contains protected program data - share only under your agreement with Glimpse / Level Data.
platforms.delivery: SFTP set up with Glimpse K12 / Level Data (or OneRoster)
platforms.confirm_with_vendor: This vendor does not publish a fixed file layout - columns are mapped when the file is uploaded. Send the vendor a sample before going live and rename headings in Step 3 if they ask.

platforms.name: Find your SAM codes (helper queries)
platforms.works_with: Use before your first export
platforms.description: Run these in SAM and save each result as a CSV with the file name shown. Then use File > SAM Codes & Schools > Import to load them: filters get drop-downs of your real codes, your schools become one-click filters, and District Settings fills in owner types and the enrolled code.
platforms.delivery: Run in SAM's Ad Hoc Query > Run Query

platforms.name: SAM setup check
platforms.works_with: Confirms how your SAM data is set up before you rely on the export packages
platforms.description: Run these seven queries in SAM once (save each result as CSV with the file name shown), then use Tools > SAM setup check to read the folder. It checks your owner type codes, enrolled code, live schedules, primary school / contact flags, roster withdrawals, homerooms, staff flags, registration (withdrawal) codes and the values used in program flags - and offers to fix District Settings. With the optional SAM connection it runs them for you. No student names leave SAM: the results are codes and counts only.
platforms.delivery: Run in SAM's Ad Hoc Query > Run Query and save as CSV

columns.column: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stuSchool AS x WHERE x.StudentID = s.StudentID AND x.PrimarySchoolFlag = 1)
columns.heading: StudentsNoPrimarySchool

columns.column: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT StudentID FROM stuSchool WHERE PrimarySchoolFlag = 1 GROUP BY StudentID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS d
columns.heading: StudentsSeveralPrimarySchools

columns.column: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StudentID) FROM StudentContact WHERE PrimaryContact = 1
columns.heading: StudentsWithPrimaryContact

columns.column: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT StudentID FROM StudentContact WHERE PrimaryContact = 1 GROUP BY StudentID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS d
columns.heading: StudentsSeveralPrimaryContacts

columns.column: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ScheduleRoster AS r JOIN ScheduleFramework AS f ON r.ScheduleFrameworkID = f.ScheduleFrameworkID JOIN ScheduleCourseTerm AS t ON f.ScheduleCourseTermID = t.ScheduleCourseTermID JOIN ScheduleCourse AS c ON t.ScheduleCourseID = c.ScheduleCourseID JOIN Schedule AS s ON c.ScheduleID = s.ScheduleID WHERE s.LiveFlag = 1
columns.heading: RosterRowsLive

columns.column: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ScheduleRoster AS r JOIN ScheduleFramework AS f ON r.ScheduleFrameworkID = f.ScheduleFrameworkID JOIN ScheduleCourseTerm AS t ON f.ScheduleCourseTermID = t.ScheduleCourseTermID JOIN ScheduleCourse AS c ON t.ScheduleCourseID = c.ScheduleCourseID JOIN Schedule AS s ON c.ScheduleID = s.ScheduleID WHERE s.LiveFlag = 1 AND NOT r.WithdrawnDate IS NULL
columns.heading: RosterRowsLiveWithdrawn

columns.column: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee AS e WHERE e.TerminationDate IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM empSchool AS x WHERE x.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID AND x.PrimarySchoolFlag = 1)

columns.column: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ScheduleFramework AS f JOIN ScheduleCourseTerm AS t ON f.ScheduleCourseTermID = t.ScheduleCourseTermID JOIN ScheduleCourse AS c ON t.ScheduleCourseID = c.ScheduleCourseID JOIN Schedule AS s ON c.ScheduleID = s.ScheduleID WHERE s.LiveFlag = 1 AND f.TeacherID IS NULL
